methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $2M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Climate & Energy (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 8 same-sector peers exist in Climate & Energy, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Determinant Materials is a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Nikhil R. Gupta that has raised $2.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of nine companies in the climate and energy sector, including one public company (LNZA) and eight private firms such as Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The stage-progression method is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using the $2.5M total raised as a proxy for base valuation and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical for seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $6M. This method is grounded in observed capital step-ups between sequential funding rounds at comparable maturity levels within the sector.

Peer-median analysis was not applicable, as the peer set lacked sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables (zero matches against the narrow filters required to yield three or more datapoints). A broader sector median would introduce unwarranted noise given the heterogeneity of stage and value across the eight private peers identified.

The triangulated valuation range is $5M to $7M, with a median of $6M. This estimate carries material uncertainty around the company's technical differentiation, capital efficiency, and path to next-stage funding—variables not captured in stage-based mechanics alone. The single-method derivation also limits confidence relative to multi-method triangulation.
